subject: Nick Giurleo City Council Candidacy
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed City Council candidate Nick Giurleo regarding his positions on the proposed comprehensive residential rezoning and city charter reform.

items.title: Residential Rezoning Proposal
items.summary: Giurleo expressed opposition to the comprehensive residential rezoning proposal, citing concerns regarding neighborhood density and the need for greater resident input after the Mayor recently canceled the consultant's contract.

items.title: City Charter Reform Ballot Question
items.summary: Giurleo endorsed the proposed city charter appearing on the November ballot, highlighting the transition from an at-large system to ward-based representation for the City Council and School Committee.
